storage.details: M.2 Key M slot for NVMe SSD (PCIe Gen3 x4) is the primary boot device on the developer kit; microSD also present.

power.connector: DC barrel jack (9-20V; ships with a 19V adapter)

firmwareCompatibility.notes: JetPack version dictates the supported CUDA/TensorRT stack and kernel.

_notes: aiTops=40 is NVIDIA's stated INT8 figure for the Orin Nano 8GB module (with sparse Tensor Cores). typicalDrawW=15 is an approximation within the documented 7W-25W configurable power-mode range; exact draw is mode- and workload-dependent. USB port counts reflect the NVIDIA developer-kit carrier board and are not guaranteed for third-party carriers.
